loading: Explicit selected parsers validate file, LOAD+stack, image-window and all existing ELF/PHDR/TLS/RELRO/layout/permission rules. Launch/exec/copy preflight precedes reset/publication or partial effects.

Existing private copy preserves page/anonymous metadata, immutable aliases, execution/TLS state and checked auxv/TID/descriptor/channel rebind. Failed staging stays unpublished and is zeroed. Confirmed terminal/reclaim invalidates grants and zeroes entire owned pool. No COW/shared-code or new mutable process table.
